descriptionByLocale.de:
NVIDIA verändert seit mehr als 25 Jahren Computergrafik, PC-Gaming und beschleunigtes Rechnen. Es ist ein einzigartiges Erbe der Innovation, das durch großartige Technologie angetrieben wird - und erstaunliche Menschen. Heute nutzen wir das unbegrenzte Potenzial der KI, um die nächste Ära des Computing zu definieren. Eine Ära, in der unsere GPU als Gehirn von Computern, Robotern und selbstfahrenden Autos fungiert, die die Welt verstehen können. Zu tun, was noch nie zuvor getan wurde, erfordert Vision, Innovation und die besten Talente der Welt. Als NVIDIAN werden Sie in eine vielfältige, unterstützende Umgebung eintauchen, in der jeder dazu inspiriert ist, seine beste Arbeit zu leisten. Treten Sie dem Team bei und sehen Sie, wie Sie die Welt nachhaltig beeinflussen können. Wir suchen einen Senior GPU Networking Architect, der unserer Netzwerksoftwaregruppe beitritt und starke GPU-Architektur und Programmierkenntnisse für den Aufbau und die Verbesserung von GPU-Kommunikationskernel mitbringt. Diese Rolle verbindet GPU-Computing mit Netzwerken, indem sichergestellt wird, dass Kommunikationsprimitive neben GPU-Hardwarefunktionen sorgfältig entwickelt werden. Schließen Sie sich unserem Team von Ingenieuren an, die die Softwaregrundlage für die größten KI-Systeme weltweit entwickeln. Was Sie tun werden:
• Erstellen, Implementieren und Optimieren von GPU-Kommunikationskernels, die kollektive und Punkt-zu-Punkt-Operationen in KI-Großsystemen unterstützen.
• Nutzen Sie fundierte Kenntnisse der GPU-Architektur - Thread Scheduling, Speicherhierarchie, Ausführungspipelines -, um die Kernel-Effizienz zu verbessern, die Latenz zu minimieren und die Berechnung mit der Kommunikation zu überlappen.
• Entwicklung von GPU-residenten Kommunikationsprimitiven und geräteseitigen APIs, die eine feinkörnige, von Kernel initiierte Datenbewegung über Knoten und Beschleuniger ermöglichen.
• Profil und Tune GPU-Kernel Ende-zu-Ende, Identifizierung von Engpässen an der Schnittstelle von Compute, Speicher und Netzwerk und gezielte Optimierungen.
• Arbeiten Sie mit Netzwerk-Software-, Hardware- und KI-Framework-Teams zusammen, um Kommunikationsstrategien zu entwickeln, die mit GPU-Ausführungsmustern und neuen Modellarchitekturen übereinstimmen.
• Erstellen Sie Konzeptnachweise, führen Sie Experimente durch und führen Sie quantitative Modellierungen durch, um neue Kommunikationsstrategien zu bewerten und zu validieren, bevor Sie sie in die Produktion überführen.
• Tragen Sie zur Entwicklung von Programmiermodellen bei, die GPU-bewusste Netzwerkfähigkeiten für Anwendungsentwickler bereitstellen. Was wir sehen müssen:
• 5+ Jahre praktische CUDA-Programmierung, einschließlich Schreiben und Optimieren von nicht-trivialen GPU-Kerneln.
• M.Sc. oder gleichwertige Erfahrung in Informatik, Computertechnik oder einem eng verwandten Bereich.
• Starkes Verständnis der GPU-Architekturgrundlagen: Warp-Planung, Shared Memory, L2-Cache, Memory Coalescing, Besetzungs-Tuning und asynchrone Ausführung.
• Erfahrung mit C/C++-Entwicklung auf Systemebene in leistungskritischen Umgebungen.
• Vertrautheit mit GPU-Datenbewegungsmechanismen wie GPUDirect RDMA und GPU-initiierter Kommunikation.
• Fähigkeit, GPU-Leistungsprofile (z. B. Nsight Compute, Nsight Systems) zu lesen und zu begründen und Beobachtungen in umsetzbare Optimierungen zu übersetzen.
• Starke Zusammenarbeit in einem multinationalen, interdisziplinären Umfeld. Möglichkeiten, sich von der Masse abzuheben:
• Erleben Sie die Entwicklung oder Optimierung von Kommunikationskernen in Bibliotheken wie NCCL, NVSHMEM oder ähnlichen GPU-fähigen Kommunikations-Frameworks.
• Verständnis von verteilten Deep-Learning-Parallelitätstechniken, einschließlich Datenparallelismus, Tensorparallelismus, Pipeline-Parallelismus, Expertenparallelismus und Mix-of-Experten-Parallelismus sowie der Kommunikationsmuster, die sie GPU-Kerneln auferlegen.
• Hintergrund in RDMA, InfiniBand, High-Speed-Networking und GPU-Systemtopologie, einschließlich NVLink, NVSwitch, PCIe und Netzwerk-Fabrics, und ihre Auswirkungen auf das Kommunikationskernel-Design.
• Erfahrung mit Überlappungstechniken wie Kernelpipelining, persistenten Kerneln oder kooperativen Gruppen, um die Kommunikationslatenz hinter Compute zu verbergen.
• Nachgewiesene Erfahrung Bewertung und Optimierung von groß angelegten LLM-Training oder Inferenz wo
descriptionByLocale.fr:
NVIDIA transforme le graphisme informatique, le jeu PC et l'informatique accélérée depuis plus de 25 ans. C'est un héritage unique d'innovation qui est alimenté par de grandes technologies – et des gens incroyables. Aujourd'hui, nous utilisons le potentiel illimité de l'IA pour définir la prochaine ère de l'informatique. Une époque où notre GPU agit comme le cerveau d'ordinateurs, de robots et de voitures autonomes qui peuvent comprendre le monde. Faire ce qui n'a jamais été fait avant prend la vision, l'innovation, et le monde des meilleurs talents. En tant que NVIDIAN, vous serez immergé dans un environnement diversifié et solidaire où tout le monde est inspiré à faire son meilleur travail. Venez rejoindre l'équipe et voir comment vous pouvez avoir un impact durable sur le monde. Nous cherchons un Senior GPU Networking Architect pour rejoindre notre groupe de logiciels de réseautage, apportant une architecture GPU forte et des compétences de programmation pour construire et améliorer les noyaux de communication GPU. Ce rôle relie l'informatique GPU à la mise en réseau en veillant à ce que les primitives de communication soient soigneusement développés aux côtés des capacités matérielles GPU. Rejoignez notre équipe d'ingénieurs développant la base logicielle des plus grands systèmes d'IA au monde. Ce que vous ferez :
• Construisez, implémentez et optimisez les noyaux de communication GPU qui sous-tendent les opérations collectives et point à point dans les systèmes d'IA à grande échelle.
• Tirer profit d'une connaissance approfondie de l'architecture GPU – planification des fils, hiérarchie de la mémoire, pipelines d'exécution – pour améliorer l'efficacité du noyau, minimiser la latence et recouper le calcul avec la communication.
• Développez des primitives de communication GPU-résident et des API côté appareil qui permettent un mouvement de données à grain fin, initié par le noyau à travers les nœuds et les accélérateurs.
• Profiler et régler les noyaux GPU de bout en bout, identifier les goulets d'étranglement à l'intersection du calcul, de la mémoire et du réseau, et conduire des optimisations ciblées.
• Collaborer avec les équipes-cadres de logiciels, de matériel et d'IA pour co-concevoir des stratégies de communication qui s'harmonisent avec les modèles d'exécution GPU et les architectures de modèles émergentes.
• Construire des preuves de conception, mener des expériences et effectuer des modélisations quantitatives pour évaluer et valider de nouvelles stratégies de communication avant de les engager à la production.
• Contribuer à l'évolution des modèles de programmation qui exposent aux développeurs d'applications les capacités de réseau averties par GPU. Ce que nous devons voir :
• 5+ ans de programmation CUDA pratique, incluant l'écriture et l'optimisation de noyaux GPU non triviaux.
• M.Sc. ou expérience équivalente en informatique, en génie informatique ou dans un domaine étroitement lié.
• Forte compréhension des fondamentaux de l'architecture GPU : programmation de distorsion, mémoire partagée, cache L2, fusion de mémoire, réglage d'occupation et exécution asynchrone.
• Expérience du développement de systèmes C/C++ dans des environnements critiques pour les performances.
• Familiarité avec les mécanismes de mouvement de données GPU tels que la RDMA GPUDirect et la communication GPU initiée.
• Capacité de lire et de raisonner sur les profils de performance GPU (p. ex., Nsight Compute, Nsight Systems) et de traduire les observations en optimisations actionnables.
• Forte capacité de collaboration dans un environnement multinational et interdisciplinaire. Des façons de se démarquer de la foule :
• Expérimentez le développement ou l'optimisation de noyaux de communication dans des bibliothèques telles que CCNL, NVSHMEM ou des cadres de communication GPU similaires.
• Compréhension des techniques de parallélisme d'apprentissage profond distribuées, y compris le parallélisme de données, le parallélisme tensor, le parallélisme de pipeline, le parallélisme d'experts et le parallélisme de mélange d'experts, et les modèles de communication qu'ils imposent aux noyaux GPU.
• Contexte dans RDMA, InfiniBand, réseau à grande vitesse et topologie du système GPU, y compris NVLink, NVSwitch, PCIe et tissus réseau, et leur impact sur la conception du noyau de communication.
• Expérience des techniques de chevauchement telles que la pipeline du noyau, les grains persistants ou les groupes coopératifs pour cacher la latence de communication derrière le calcul.
• Expérience éprouvée en matière d'évaluation et d'optimisation de la formation ou de l'inférence LLM à grande échelle

• Forte background di programmazione in C++, Python, e idealmente CUDA o altri modelli di programmazione GPU, con un track record di produzione-qualità di prestazioni-critical software.
• Ampia esperienza pratica con i framework AI (per esempio PyTorch, TensorFlow, JAX) e una solida comprensione di come le librerie di comunicazione e i sistemi runtime facilitino la formazione su larga scala e l'inferenza.
• Dimostrato successo nello sviluppo e nella raffinazione di sistemi ad alto rendimento, bassa latenza, tra cui la capacità di ragionare tra stack software, funzionalità hardware e strozzature di sistema.
• Forte capacità di collaborazione in un ambiente multi-nazionale, interdisciplinare, con la capacità di contribuire idee, costruire slancio e lavorare efficacemente con ingegneri senior, ricercatori e team partner. Modi per distinguersi dalla folla:
• Profonda competenza con le librerie di comunicazione NCCL, UCX, UCC o simili utilizzate nei carichi di lavoro AI e HPC su larga scala.
• Forte sfondo nei protocolli di rete e comunicazione, RDMA, comunicazioni collettive, trasporto congestion-aware, o networking acceleratore-consapevole.
• Conoscenza completa della formazione e dell'inferenza di modelli di grandi dimensioni che servono a scala, compresi i colli di bottiglia di comunicazione, le sfide di programmazione e i tradeoff di livello di sistema in elaborazione, memoria e tessuto.

descriptionByLocale.en:
NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It’s a unique legacy of innovation that’s fueled by great technology—and amazing people. Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world.

We are looking for a Senior HPC and AI Network Software Architect to help build the next generation of scalable AI infrastructure. The role emphasizes distributed training, real-time inference, and communication efficiency across large systems. You will develop new software and hardware approaches, shape platform evolution through hands-on innovation, and contribute to designing systems powering the fastest AI workloads globally. Collaborate with our distinguished team of researchers and engineers building software and hardware for AI at an outstanding scale.

What you will be doing:

• Build and evolve the architecture of scalable software systems for distributed AI training and inference, focusing on throughput, latency, resiliency, and memory efficiency across cluster-scale deployments.

• Develop and evaluate next-generation communication and runtime capabilities in libraries such as NCCL, UCX, and UCC, tailored to the evolving demands of frontier AI workloads.

• Partner with AI framework teams (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch, JAX) and internal platform teams to build integrations, explore new approaches, and improve end-to-end performance and reliability.

• Collaborate on hardware and system-level features across GPUs, DPUs, and interconnects to speed up data movement and enable new capabilities for training, inference, and model serving at scale.

• Drive innovation across runtime systems, communication libraries, and AI-specific protocol layers, helping turn new ideas into practical capabilities and robust implementations.

What we need to see:

• Ph.D., or equivalent industry experience, in computer science, computer engineering, or a closely related field.

• 5+ years of experience in systems programming, parallel or distributed computing, high-performance networking, or large-scale data movement, including experience designing and building complex systems.

• Strong programming background in C++, Python, and ideally CUDA or other GPU programming models, with a track record of building production-quality performance-critical software.

• Extensive hands-on experience with AI frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow, JAX) and a solid grasp of how communication libraries and runtime systems facilitate large-scale training and inference.

• Demonstrated success in developing and refining high-throughput, low-latency systems, including the ability to reason across software stacks, hardware capabilities, and system bottlenecks.

• Strong collaboration skills in a multi-national, interdisciplinary setting, with the ability to contribute ideas, build momentum, and work effectively with senior engineers, researchers, and partner teams.

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

• Deep expertise with NCCL, UCX, UCC, or similar communication libraries used in large-scale AI and HPC workloads.

• Strong background in networking and communication protocols, RDMA, collective communications, congestion-aware transport, or accelerator-aware networking.

• Comprehensive knowledge of large model training and inference serving at scale, including communication bottlenecks, scheduling challenges, and system-level tradeoffs across compute, memory, and fabric.

• Experience crafting hardware-software co-design for distributed AI systems, including contribu

Une époque où notre GPU agit comme le cerveau d'ordinateurs, de robots et de voitures autonomes qui peuvent comprendre le monde. jobs.description:
We are looking to hire a CPU Compiler Engineer for an exciting and fun role at NVIDIA. We craft outstanding compilers that realise the potential of NVIDIA's CPUs designed for the world's largest AI and HPC workloads: https://www.nvidia.com/en-in/data-center/grace-cpu/ . Our compiler organisation makes its mark on every CPU, GPU, DPU and SoC product that NVIDIA builds. Would you like to be part of this outstanding organisation?

We need you to design, develop and help improve the upstream LLVM Toolchain for NVIDIA's CPUs. These compilers are key for the performance of AI, HPC and other performance critical software deployed on NVIDIA Data Centres, on the cloud and at super computing centres around the world. In this role you will solve critical problems working alongside an outstanding engineering team with vision in Compiler technology and systems software, doing what you enjoy! You will also be collaborating with the relevant upstream projects and improving the state of the art. If this sounds like a fun challenge, we would be delighted to hear from you!!

What you will be doing:

• Work with a geographically distributed partner organisation to understand, modify and improve CPU Compiler SW at NVIDIA.

• Contribute new features and optimisation techniques targeting NVIDIA Grace CPUs engaging with upstream and open source communities.

• Develop compiler SW that is optimised for performance.

• Be part of a team that is at the centre of AI, HPC and data centre technologies.

• Help in the development of next generation CPU micro-architecture.

What we need to see:

• BS or MS degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related field or equivalent experience

• More than 12 years of experience with compiler development in a production environment.

• Knowledge of Language Front-Ends or Compiler optimisation techniques and code generation modules.

• Strong hands-on C++ programming skills

• Excellent verbal and written communications skills

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

• Familiarity with CPU architectures such as Arm Architecture (AArch32, AArch64), RISC-V, x86_64, PowerPC or DSPs and engaging with pre-silicon compiler and toolchain contributions.

• A track record of working with industry standard compiler infrastructure such as LLVM

• Knowledge of AI algorithms, scientific HPC applications and related code optimisations.

• Meaningful contributions to free software and open source compiler communities.

With highly competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits package, NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most innovative and talented people on the planet working for us and, due to unprecedented growth, our world-class engineering teams are expanding fast. If you're a creative and autonomous engineer with a genuine passion for technology, we want to hear from you.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

• Contribuisci nuove funzionalità e tecniche di ottimizzazione che mirano alle CPU NVIDIA Grace coinvolgendo comunità a monte e open source.

• Più di 12 anni di esperienza con lo sviluppo del compilatore in un ambiente di produzione.
• Conoscenza delle tecniche di ottimizzazione del linguaggio Front-Ends o Compiler e dei moduli di generazione del codice.

• Familiarità con le architetture della CPU come Arm Architecture (AArch32, AArch64), RISC-V, x86 64, PowerPC o DSP e con contributi pre-silicon compilatore e toolchain.
• Un track record di lavoro con l'infrastruttura di compilatore standard del settore come LLVM
• Conoscenza degli algoritmi AI, applicazioni HPC scientifiche e relative ottimizzazioni del codice.
• Contributi significativi alle comunità di compilatori di software libero e open source. Con salari altamente competitivi e un pacchetto di benefici completi, NVIDIA è ampiamente considerato uno dei datori di lavoro più desiderabili del mondo tecnologico. Se sei un ingegnere creativo e autonomo con una vera passione per la tecnologia, vogliamo sentire da te. Siamo un datore di lavoro di pari opportunità e la diversità di valore nella nostra azienda. Non discriviamo sulla base di razza, religione, colore, origine nazionale, sesso, orientamento sessuale, età, stato civile, stato veterano, o stato di disabilità.

jobs.description:
The DGX Cloud organization at NVIDIA brings together cutting-edge hardware and software innovation to deliver industry-leading accelerated computing for the world's most adventurous AI workloads. We're a team of innovative engineers dedicated to solving some of the world's biggest challenges, constantly driving advancements, and impacting millions of lives worldwide!

We are looking for an outstanding Senior Systems Software Engineer with deep experience in distributed systems, open-source technologies such as Kubernetes and containers, and a strong background in systems performance and scalability. The ideal candidate brings broad, end-to-end experience across the stack - from GPU operator and device plugins to distributed inference serving and cloud platforms - along with the technical depth to investigate and address exciting, real-world problems at scale. In this pivotal role, you will take on the challenge of scaling AI infrastructure while optimizing total cost of ownership, driving down cost per token to unlock the next generation of AI innovation and AI factories!

What you'll be doing:

• Drive end-to-end performance and scale characterization for the NVIDIA DGX Cloud software stack, from Kubernetes control and data planes through NVIDIA components such as GPU Operator, Network Operator, DCGM, NIM, and distributed inference serving, following issues from orchestration down to the metal.

• Collaborate with AI researchers, developers and customers to develop innovative, automated tests that simulate real user workloads using custom-built and leading open-source tools and frameworks.

• Deep dive into performance and scale issues in complex distributed systems, including interactions between Kubernetes and the NVIDIA software stack, to identify and resolve root causes.

• Design and develop monitoring, reporting and analysis tools for performance and scale testing across software, GPU and CPU resources.

• Triage, debug and root cause issues related to operating Kubernetes clusters at ultra-large scale, ensuring reliability and efficiency.

• Build and maintain a high-velocity framework that enables continuous, always-on performance and scale testing via a modern CI/CD pipeline.

• Document research, methodologies and results clearly and concisely, and present findings at internal and external venues, including community conferences such as KubeCon and GTC.

• Engage efficiently with upstream communities — including Kubernetes, CNCF and NVIDIA open-source projects — to validate performance and scalability of AI workloads early and help shape design and development decisions.

What we need to see:

• 8+ years of experience Computer Architecture, Networking, Storage systems, Accelerators and Bachelors/Masters in Engineering (preferably, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or Computer Science) or equivalent experience

• Expertise in Kubernetes and familiarity with related CNCF projects

• Background in working with large scale parallel and distributed accelerator-based systems

• Expertise optimizing performance and AI workloads on large scale systems

• Experience with performance modeling and benchmarking at scale

• Proficiency in Golang/Python

• Background with the NVIDIA software ecosystem in both training and inference domains

• Expertise with at least one of public CSP infrastructure (GCP, AWS, Azure, OCI for example)

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

• Strong operational experience with any one of the Kubernetes distributions

• Prior experience scaling Kubernetes clusters to ultra-large node and object counts

• Demonstrated history of working in the open-source community

• Excellent communication and interpersonal abilities

• PhD in relevant areas

NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people in the world working for us. If you're creative and autonomous, we want to hear from you!

Yo

descriptionByLocale.it:
L'organizzazione DGX Cloud di NVIDIA riunisce l'innovazione hardware e software all'avanguardia per fornire un calcolo accelerato leader del settore per i carichi di lavoro AI più avventurosi al mondo. Siamo un team di ingegneri innovativi dedicati a risolvere alcune delle sfide più grandi del mondo, guidando costantemente i progressi, e impatto milioni di vite in tutto il mondo! Siamo alla ricerca di un eccezionale Senior Systems Software Engineer con profonda esperienza in sistemi distribuiti, tecnologie open source come Kubernetes e contenitori, e un forte background in prestazioni e scalabilità dei sistemi. Il candidato ideale porta un'esperienza ampia e end-to-end in tutto lo stack - da operatore GPU e plug-in per dispositivi a piattaforme cloud e inferenza distribuite - insieme alla profondità tecnica per indagare e affrontare problemi entusiasmanti e reali in scala. In questo ruolo fondamentale, si assumerà la sfida di scalare l'infrastruttura AI, ottimizzando il costo totale di proprietà, riducendo i costi per gettone per sbloccare la prossima generazione di AI innovazione e AI fabbriche! Cosa farai:
• Guidare le prestazioni end-to-end e la caratterizzazione in scala per lo stack software NVIDIA DGX Cloud, dal controllo Kubernetes e dai piani di dati attraverso componenti NVIDIA come GPU Operator, Network Operator, DCGM, NIM e il servizio di inferenza distribuito, a seguito di problemi da orchestrazione fino al metallo.
• Collabora con ricercatori, sviluppatori e clienti AI per sviluppare test innovativi e automatizzati che simulano carichi di lavoro reali degli utenti utilizzando strumenti e framework open source personalizzati e leader.
• Immergetevi profondamente nelle problematiche delle prestazioni e della scala nei sistemi distribuiti complessi, comprese le interazioni tra Kubernetes e lo stack software NVIDIA, per identificare e risolvere le cause root.
• Progettare e sviluppare strumenti di monitoraggio, reporting e analisi per il test di performance e scala su risorse software, GPU e CPU.
• Triage, debug e root causano problemi legati al funzionamento di cluster Kubernetes a larga scala, garantendo affidabilità ed efficienza.
• Costruisci e mantieni un framework ad alta velocità che consente di effettuare test continui e sempre in scala tramite una moderna pipeline CI/CD.
• Ricerca di documenti, metodologie e risultati concisamente e concisamente, e presenti risultati in sedi interne ed esterne, tra cui conferenze comunitarie come KubeCon e GTC.
• Coinvolgere in modo efficiente con le comunità a monte — tra cui Kubernetes, CNCF e progetti open source NVIDIA — per convalidare le prestazioni e la scalabilità dei carichi di lavoro AI precocemente e aiutare a modellare le decisioni di progettazione e sviluppo. Cosa dobbiamo vedere:
• 8+ anni di esperienza Computer Architecture, Networking, Sistemi di memorizzazione, Acceleratori e Bachelor/Master in Ingegneria (preferibilmente, Ingegneria Elettrica, Ingegneria Informatica o Scienza Informatica) o esperienza equivalente
• Competenza in Kubernetes e familiarità con i progetti CNCF correlati
• Sfondo di lavoro con sistemi basati su acceleratori paralleli e distribuiti su larga scala
• Competenza ottimizzando le prestazioni e i carichi di lavoro AI su sistemi su larga scala
• Esperienza con modellazione delle prestazioni e benchmarking su scala
• Proficienza in Golang/Python
• Sfondo con l'ecosistema software NVIDIA sia nei domini di formazione che di inferenza
• Competenza con almeno una delle infrastrutture CSP pubbliche (GCP, AWS, Azure, OCI per esempio) Modi per distinguersi dalla folla:
• Forte esperienza operativa con una delle distribuzioni Kubernetes
• Esperienza precedente scalare cluster Kubernetes a nodo ultra-grande e conteggi oggetti
• Storia dimostrata di lavorare nella comunità open source
• Ottima comunicazione e capacità interpersonali
• PhD in aree rilevanti NVIDIA è ampiamente considerato uno dei datori di lavoro più desiderabili del mondo tecnologico. Abbiamo alcune delle persone più avanzate e laboriose al mondo che lavorano per noi. Se sei creativo e autonomo, vogliamo sentirti! Ehi.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Die DGX Cloud-Organisation von NVIDIA vereint innovative Hardware- und Software-Innovationen, um branchenführendes beschleunigtes Computing für die weltweit abenteuerlichsten KI-Workloads zu liefern. Wir sind ein Team innovativer Ingenieure, die sich der Lösung einiger der größten Herausforderungen der Welt widmen, ständig Fortschritte vorantreiben und Millionen von Leben weltweit beeinflussen! Wir suchen einen hervorragenden Senior Systems Software Engineer mit fundierter Erfahrung in verteilten Systemen, Open-Source-Technologien wie Kubernetes und Containern und einem starken Hintergrund in Bezug auf Systemleistung und Skalierbarkeit. Der ideale Kandidat bringt eine breite, durchgängige Erfahrung über den gesamten Stack - von GPU-Betreibern und Geräte-Plugins bis hin zu verteilten Inferenz-Serving- und Cloud-Plattformen - zusammen mit der technischen Tiefe, um spannende, reale Probleme in großem Maßstab zu untersuchen und anzugehen. In dieser zentralen Rolle nehmen Sie die Herausforderung an, die KI-Infrastruktur zu skalieren und gleichzeitig die Gesamtbetriebskosten zu optimieren, um die Kosten pro Token zu senken und die nächste Generation von KI-Innovationen und KI-Fabriken freizuschalten! Was Sie tun werden:
• Fahren Sie die End-to-End-Performance und Skalierungscharakterisierung für den NVIDIA DGX Cloud-Software-Stack von Kubernetes-Steuerungs- und Datenebenen über NVIDIA-Komponenten wie GPU Operator, Network Operator, DCGM, NIM und Distributed Inference Serving nach Problemen von der Orchestrierung bis hin zum Metall.
• Arbeiten Sie mit KI-Forschern, Entwicklern und Kunden zusammen, um innovative, automatisierte Tests zu entwickeln, die echte Benutzer-Workloads mit maßgeschneiderten und führenden Open-Source-Tools und Frameworks simulieren.
• Tauchen Sie ein in Performance- und Skalierungsprobleme in komplexen verteilten Systemen, einschließlich Interaktionen zwischen Kubernetes und dem NVIDIA-Software-Stack, um Ursachen zu identifizieren und zu beheben.
• Entwurf und Entwicklung von Überwachungs-, Berichts- und Analysetools für Leistungs- und Skalierungstests über Software-, GPU- und CPU-Ressourcen hinweg.
• Triage, Debug und Root verursachen Probleme im Zusammenhang mit dem Betrieb von Kubernetes-Clustern in ultragroßem Maßstab, was Zuverlässigkeit und Effizienz gewährleistet.
• Bauen und pflegen Sie ein Hochgeschwindigkeits-Framework, das kontinuierliche, ständige Leistungs- und Skalierungstests über eine moderne CI/CD-Pipeline ermöglicht.
• Dokumentieren Sie Forschung, Methoden und Ergebnisse klar und prägnant und präsentieren Sie die Ergebnisse auf internen und externen Veranstaltungsorten, einschließlich Community-Konferenzen wie KubeCon und GTC.
• Engagieren Sie sich effizient mit Upstream-Communities - einschließlich Kubernetes-, CNCF- und NVIDIA-Open-Source-Projekten -, um die Leistung und Skalierbarkeit von KI-Workloads frühzeitig zu validieren und Design- und Entwicklungsentscheidungen zu gestalten. Was wir sehen müssen:
• 8+ Jahre Erfahrung in Computerarchitektur, Networking, Storage Systems, Accelerators und Bachelor / Master in Engineering (vorzugsweise Elektrotechnik, Computer Engineering oder Informatik) oder gleichwertige Erfahrung
• Expertise in Kubernetes und Vertrautheit mit verwandten CNCF-Projekten
• Hintergrund in der Arbeit mit groß angelegten parallelen und verteilten Beschleuniger-basierten Systemen
• Kompetenz zur Optimierung von Leistung und KI-Workloads in großen Systemen
• Erfahrung mit Performance Modeling und Benchmarking im Maßstab
• Kenntnisse in Golang/Python
• Hintergrund zum NVIDIA Software-Ökosystem sowohl in den Bereichen Training als auch Inferenz
• Expertise mit mindestens einer öffentlichen CSP-Infrastruktur (z. B. GCP, AWS, Azure, OCI) Möglichkeiten, sich von der Masse abzuheben:
• Starke operative Erfahrung mit einer der Kubernetes-Distributionen
• Skalierung von Kubernetes-Clustern auf ultragroße Knoten- und Objektzählungen
• Demonstrierte Geschichte der Arbeit in der Open-Source-Community
• Ausgezeichnete Kommunikation und zwischenmenschliche Fähigkeiten
• PhD in relevanten Bereichen NVIDIA gilt weithin als einer der begehrtesten Arbeitgeber der Technologie weltweit. Wir haben einige der fortschrittlichsten und fleißigsten Menschen der Welt, die für uns arbeiten. Wenn Sie kreativ und autonom sind, möchten wir von Ihnen hören! Yo
descriptionByLocale.fr:
L'organisation DGX Cloud de NVIDIA rassemble des innovations de pointe dans le domaine du matériel et des logiciels afin d'offrir une informatique accélérée de pointe pour les charges de travail les plus aventureuses au monde en matière d'IA. Nous sommes une équipe d'ingénieurs innovants qui s'emploient à résoudre certains des plus grands défis du monde, à constamment conduire des progrès et à toucher des millions de vies dans le monde entier ! Nous sommes à la recherche d'un ingénieur logiciel senior de premier plan avec une expérience approfondie dans les systèmes distribués, les technologies open-source telles que Kubernetes et conteneurs, et une solide expérience dans la performance et l'évolutivité des systèmes. Le candidat idéal apporte une vaste expérience de bout en bout à travers la pile - de l'opérateur GPU et des plugins d'appareil à la distribution de services d'inférence et plates-formes cloud - ainsi que la profondeur technique pour étudier et résoudre des problèmes réels passionnants à l'échelle. Dans ce rôle central, vous allez relever le défi de l'échelle des infrastructures d'IA tout en optimisant le coût total de la propriété, en réduisant les coûts par jeton pour débloquer la prochaine génération d'innovations d'IA et d'usines d'IA! Ce que tu vas faire :
• Conduisez les performances de bout en bout et la caractérisation d'échelle pour la pile logicielle NVIDIA DGX Cloud, depuis les plans de contrôle et de données de Kubernetes jusqu'aux composants NVIDIA tels que l'opérateur GPU, l'opérateur réseau, DCGM, NIM, et le service d'inférence distribué, suite à des questions allant de l'orchestration au métal.
• Collaborez avec des chercheurs, des développeurs et des clients d'IA pour développer des tests automatisés et innovants qui simulent la charge de travail réelle des utilisateurs en utilisant des outils et des cadres open-source conçus sur mesure.
• Plongez profondément dans les problèmes de performance et d'échelle dans les systèmes distribués complexes, y compris les interactions entre Kubernetes et la pile logicielle NVIDIA, pour identifier et résoudre les causes profondes.
• Concevoir et élaborer des outils de surveillance, de rapport et d'analyse pour les tests de performance et d'échelle à l'aide de logiciels, de GPU et de CPU.
• Le triage, le débogage et les causes profondes des problèmes liés à l'exploitation des grappes Kubernetes à grande échelle, assurant fiabilité et efficacité.
• Construisez et maintenez un cadre à grande vitesse qui permet des essais continus et toujours à l'échelle grâce à un pipeline CI/CD moderne.
• Documenter la recherche, les méthodologies et les résultats de façon claire et concise, et présenter les résultats dans des lieux internes et externes, y compris des conférences communautaires comme KubeCon et GTC.
• S'engager efficacement avec les collectivités en amont — y compris Kubernetes, CNCF et NVIDIA — pour valider rapidement la performance et l'évolutivité de la charge de travail de l'IA et aider à façonner les décisions de conception et de développement. Ce que nous devons voir :
• 8 ans et plus d'expérience Architecture informatique, réseau, systèmes de stockage, accélérateurs et baccalauréats/maîtrise en génie (de préférence, génie électrique, génie informatique ou informatique) ou expérience équivalente
• Expertise en Kubernetes et connaissance des projets du CNCF
• Contexte dans le travail avec des systèmes à grande échelle parallèles et distribués à base d'accélérateur
• Expertise optimisant les performances et la charge de travail de l'IA sur les systèmes à grande échelle
• Expérience de la modélisation des performances et de l'étalonnage à l'échelle
• Compétence au Golang/Python
• Contexte de l'écosystème logiciel NVIDIA dans les domaines de la formation et de l'inférence
• Expertise avec au moins une des infrastructures publiques du PSC (GCP, AWS, Azure, OCI par exemple) Des façons de se démarquer de la foule :
• Forte expérience opérationnelle avec l'une des distributions Kubernetes
• Expérimentation de l'expérience préalable Kubernetes clusters to ultra-large node and object counts
• Antécédents de travail démontrés dans la communauté ouverte
• Excellente communication et aptitudes interpersonnelles
• Doctorat dans les domaines pertinents NVIDIA est largement considéré comme l'un des employeurs les plus souhaitables du monde de la technologie. Il candidato ideale porta un'esperienza ampia e end-to-end in tutto lo stack - da operatore GPU e plug-in per dispositivi a piattaforme cloud e inferenza distribuite - insieme alla profondità tecnica per indagare e affrontare problemi entusiasmanti e reali in scala. • Competenza in Kubernetes e familiarità con i progetti CNCF correlati
• Sfondo di lavoro con sistemi basati su acceleratori paralleli e distribuiti su larga scala
• Competenza ottimizzando le prestazioni e i carichi di lavoro AI su sistemi su larga scala

• Forte esperienza operativa con una delle distribuzioni Kubernetes

descriptionByLocale.en:
The DGX Cloud organization at NVIDIA brings together cutting-edge hardware and software innovation to deliver industry-leading accelerated computing for the world's most adventurous AI workloads. We're a team of innovative engineers dedicated to solving some of the world's biggest challenges, constantly driving advancements, and impacting millions of lives worldwide!

We are looking for an outstanding Systems Software Engineer with deep experience in distributed systems, open-source technologies such as Kubernetes and containers, and a strong background in systems performance and scalability. The ideal candidate brings broad, end-to-end experience across the stack - from GPU operator and device plugins to distributed inference serving and cloud platforms - along with the technical depth to investigate and address exciting, real-world problems at scale. In this pivotal role, you will take on the challenge of scaling AI infrastructure while optimizing total cost of ownership, driving down cost per token to unlock the next generation of AI innovation and AI factories!

What you'll be doing:

• Drive end-to-end performance and scale characterization for the NVIDIA DGX Cloud software stack, from Kubernetes control and data planes through NVIDIA components such as GPU Operator, Network Operator, DCGM, NIM, and distributed inference serving, following issues from orchestration down to the metal.

• Collaborate with AI researchers, developers and customers to develop innovative, automated tests that simulate real user workloads using custom-built and leading open-source tools and frameworks.

• Deep dive into performance and scale issues in complex distributed systems, including interactions between Kubernetes and the NVIDIA software stack, to identify and resolve root causes.

• Design and develop monitoring, reporting and analysis tools for performance and scale testing across software, GPU and CPU resources.

• Triage, debug and root cause issues related to operating Kubernetes clusters at ultra-large scale, ensuring reliability and efficiency.

• Build and maintain a high-velocity framework that enables continuous, always-on performance and scale testing via a modern CI/CD pipeline.

• Document research, methodologies and results clearly and concisely, and present findings at internal and external venues, including community conferences such as KubeCon and GTC.

• Engage efficiently with upstream communities — including Kubernetes, CNCF and NVIDIA open-source projects — to validate performance and scalability of AI workloads early and help shape design and development decisions.

What we need to see:

• 2+ years of experience Computer Architecture, Networking, Storage systems, Accelerators and Bachelors/Masters in Engineering (preferably, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or Computer Science) or equivalent experience

• Expertise in Kubernetes and familiarity with related CNCF projects

• Background in working with large scale parallel and distributed accelerator-based systems

• Expertise optimizing performance and AI workloads on large scale systems

• Experience with performance modeling and benchmarking at scale

• Proficiency in Golang/Python

• Background with the NVIDIA software ecosystem in both training and inference domains

• Expertise with at least one of public CSP infrastructure (GCP, AWS, Azure, OCI for example)

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

• Strong operational experience with any one of the Kubernetes distributions

• Prior experience scaling Kubernetes clusters to ultra-large node and object counts

• Demonstrated history of working in the open-source community

• Excellent communication and interpersonal abilities

• PhD in relevant areas

NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people in the world working for us. If you're creative and autonomous, we want to hear from you!

Your base

jobs.description:
At NVIDIA, we build the simulation technologies powering the future of robotics, industrial AI, autonomous systems, and digital twins.

NVIDIA Omniverse simulation technologies are used to power reinforcement learning systems, train robots, simulate factories and warehouses, and enable physically accurate digital twins.
As simulation becomes foundational to robotics and industrial automation, the demands on physical fidelity are rapidly increasing. Automotive, aerospace, manufacturing, and robotics require simulations that go beyond visual plausibility and reach engineering-grade predictive accuracy.
We are looking for a senior technical leader who can raise the fidelity, robustness, and practical value of our engineering simulation stack for robotics, automation, and industrial digital twins. Rather than focusing on visual plausibility, this is a role for someone who has already built simulation technology used to make decisions about real machines: robots, industrial equipment, vehicles, flexible assemblies, or other complex electromechanical systems. You should be comfortable turning ambiguous real-world behavior into tractable models, choosing the right level of fidelity for the problem, validating those models against data, and driving production-quality implementation in a modern agentic AI based accelerated-computing environment.

In this role, you will help define and implement the next generation of high-fidelity simulation capabilities across NVIDIA’s robotics and industrial simulation stack. You will work on difficult mechanics problems that matter in the real world, including articulated machines, contact-rich interactions, frictional systems, deformable or compliant components, and flexible elements such as cables, wires, dresspacks, or harness-like assemblies. You will collaborate closely with teams across physics, robotics, digital twins, controls, and GPU software to turn advanced simulation methods into scalable developer and product capabilities.

What you’ll be doing:

• Design and develop advanced physically based simulation systems for robotics and industrial digital twins.

• Collaborate with teams across PhysX, Newton, Omniverse, and Isaac robotics.

• Bring modern industrial and engineering simulation methodologies into NVIDIA’s scalable simulation stack.

• Design, evaluate and improve methods for multibody dynamics, contact and friction, flexible-body behavior, deformables, and related numerical solvers.

• Integrate simulation with robotics workflows involving ROS 2, CAD and URDF pipelines, OpenUSD assets, HIL/SIL environments, and controller-development loops.

• Assist GPU accelerated implementations and scale out of advanced simulation algorithms.

• Mentor engineers and contribute technical leadership across the organization!

What we need to see:

• A track record of building or leading simulation software used in production engineering, robotics, industrial machinery, automotive, aerospace, manufacturing, or adjacent domains.

• 15+ years of relevant industry experience, demonstrating sustained impact in simulation development, system design, or engineering software at scale.

• Master’s or PhD degree in a relevant discipline (e.g., mechanical engineering, robotics, computer science, applied mathematics, or physics), or equivalent depth of expertise through professional experience

• Deep knowledge in several of the following areas: multibody dynamics, constrained systems, contact and friction, articulations, flexible bodies, cable or wire simulation, deformables, FEM, solver design, numerical integration, stiffness handling, or model reduction.

• Experience validating simulators against physical systems, including some combination of test correlation, calibration, HIL/SIL workflows, or controller co-simulation.

• Working fluency in robotics-system integration and mechanical-engineering toolchains, including ROS 2, Simulink, Simscape, and model pipelines based on CAD, URDF, MJCF, or OpenU

descriptionByLocale.it:
A NVIDIA, costruiamo le tecnologie di simulazione che alimentano il futuro della robotica, dell'IA industriale, dei sistemi autonomi e dei gemelli digitali. Le tecnologie di simulazione omniverse NVIDIA sono utilizzate per potenziare i sistemi di apprendimento, addestrare i robot, simulare le fabbriche e i magazzini e attivare i gemelli digitali fisicamente accurati. Poiché la simulazione diventa fondamentale per la robotica e l'automazione industriale, le richieste di fedeltà fisica stanno aumentando rapidamente. Automotive, aerospaziale, manifatturiera e robotica richiedono simulazioni che vanno oltre plausibilità visiva e raggiungono precisione predittiva di livello ingegneristico. Siamo alla ricerca di un leader tecnico senior che possa aumentare la fedeltà, la robustezza e il valore pratico del nostro stack di simulazione ingegneristica per robotica, automazione e gemelle digitali industriali. Piuttosto che puntare sulla plausibilità visiva, questo è un ruolo per qualcuno che ha già costruito la tecnologia di simulazione utilizzata per prendere decisioni su macchine reali: robot, attrezzature industriali, veicoli, assemblaggi flessibili, o altri sistemi elettromeccanici complessi. Si dovrebbe essere comodo trasformare ambiguo comportamento del mondo reale in modelli trattabili, scegliendo il giusto livello di fedeltà per il problema, convalidando quei modelli contro i dati, e guidando l'implementazione di qualità della produzione in un moderno agente AI basato ambiente accelerato-computing. In questo ruolo, si contribuirà a definire e implementare la prossima generazione di funzionalità di simulazione ad alta fedeltà attraverso la robotica e lo stack di simulazione industriale di NVIDIA. Potrai lavorare su problemi meccanici difficili che importano nel mondo reale, tra cui macchine articolate, interazioni ricche di contatti, sistemi di attrito, componenti deformabili o conformi, e elementi flessibili come cavi, fili, dresspack, o assemblaggi imbrigliati. Collaborerai a stretto contatto con team di fisica, robotica, gemelli digitali, controlli e software GPU per trasformare i metodi di simulazione avanzati in capacità di sviluppo e di prodotto scalabili. Cosa farai:
• Progettare e sviluppare avanzati sistemi di simulazione fisicamente basati per robot e gemelli digitali industriali.
• Collabora con team di PhysX, Newton, Omniverse e Isaac robotics.
• Portare moderne metodologie di simulazione industriale e ingegneristica nello stack di simulazione scalabile di NVIDIA.
• Progettare, valutare e migliorare i metodi per le dinamiche multicorpo, il contatto e l'attrito, il comportamento flessibile del corpo, deformabili e i relativi risolutori numerici.
• Integrare la simulazione con flussi di lavoro robotici che coinvolgono tubazioni ROS 2, CAD e URDF, attività OpenUSD, ambienti HIL/SIL e loop di sviluppo del controller.
• Assist GPU accelerato implementazioni e scala da algoritmi di simulazione avanzati.
• Gli ingegneri del mentore e contribuiscono alla leadership tecnica in tutta l'organizzazione! Cosa dobbiamo vedere:
• Un track record di costruzione o software di simulazione leader utilizzato in ingegneria di produzione, robotica, macchinari industriali, automobilistico, aerospaziale, produzione o domini adiacenti.
• 15+ anni di esperienza industriale rilevante, dimostrando un impatto duraturo nello sviluppo della simulazione, nella progettazione del sistema o nel software di ingegneria in scala.
• Laurea magistrale o dottorato in una disciplina rilevante (ad esempio, ingegneria meccanica, robotica, informatica, matematica applicata o fisica), o profondità equivalente di competenza attraverso l'esperienza professionale
• Conoscenza profonda in diverse delle seguenti aree: dinamica multicorpo, sistemi di contenimento, contatto e attrito, articolazioni, corpi flessibili, simulazione di cavi o fili, deformables, FEM, design del risolutore, integrazione numerica, gestione della rigidità, o riduzione del modello.
• Prova a convalidare simulatori contro i sistemi fisici, tra cui una combinazione di correlazione di test, calibrazione, flussi di lavoro HIL/SIL o co-simulation del controller.
• Fluency di lavoro nell'integrazione robots-system e nelle catene utensili di ingegneria meccanica, tra cui ROS 2, Simulink, Simscape e modelli basati su CAD, URDF, MJCF o OpenU

Bei NVIDIA entwickeln wir Simulationstechnologien, die die Zukunft von Robotik, industrieller KI, autonomen Systemen und digitalen Zwillingen vorantreiben. NVIDIA Omniverse-Simulationstechnologien werden verwendet, um verstärkende Lernsysteme anzutreiben, Roboter zu trainieren, Fabriken und Lager zu simulieren und physisch genaue digitale Zwillinge zu ermöglichen. Automobile, Luft- und Raumfahrt, Fertigung und Robotik erfordern Simulationen, die über die visuelle Plausibilität hinausgehen und eine prädiktive Genauigkeit in technischer Hinsicht erreichen. Wir suchen einen leitenden technischen Leiter, der die Treue, Robustheit und den praktischen Wert unseres Engineering-Simulations-Stacks für Robotik, Automatisierung und industrielle digitale Zwillinge erhöhen kann. Anstatt sich auf visuelle Plausibilität zu konzentrieren, ist dies eine Rolle für jemanden, der bereits Simulationstechnologie entwickelt hat, mit der Entscheidungen über reale Maschinen getroffen werden: Roboter, Industrieanlagen, Fahrzeuge, flexible Baugruppen oder andere komplexe elektromechanische Systeme. Sie sollten sich wohl dabei fühlen, mehrdeutiges Verhalten in der realen Welt in praktikable Modelle umzuwandeln, die richtige Genauigkeit für das Problem zu wählen, diese Modelle gegen Daten zu validieren und die Implementierung der Produktionsqualität in einer modernen agentischen KI-basierten beschleunigten Rechenumgebung voranzutreiben. In dieser Rolle helfen Sie bei der Definition und Implementierung der nächsten Generation von High-Fidelity-Simulationsfunktionen für den Robotik- und Industriesimulationsstack von NVIDIA. Sie werden an schwierigen mechanischen Problemen arbeiten, die in der realen Welt von Bedeutung sind, einschließlich Gelenkmaschinen, kontaktreiche Interaktionen, Reibungssysteme, deformierbare oder nachgiebige Komponenten und flexible Elemente wie Kabel, Drähte, Dresspacks oder geschirrähnliche Baugruppen. Sie arbeiten eng mit Teams aus den Bereichen Physik, Robotik, digitale Zwillinge, Steuerungen und GPU-Software zusammen, um fortschrittliche Simulationsmethoden in skalierbare Entwickler- und Produktfunktionen umzuwandeln. Was du tun wirst:
• Entwerfen und entwickeln Sie fortschrittliche physikalisch basierte Simulationssysteme für Robotik und industrielle digitale Zwillinge.
• Arbeiten Sie mit Teams aus den Bereichen PhysX, Newton, Omniverse und Isaac Robotik zusammen.
• Bringen Sie moderne industrielle und technische Simulationsmethoden in den skalierbaren Simulationsstack von NVIDIA ein.
• Entwerfen, bewerten und verbessern Sie Methoden für Mehrkörperdynamik, Kontakt und Reibung, flexibles Körperverhalten, Deformables und verwandte numerische Solver.
• Integrieren Sie die Simulation mit Robotik-Workflows mit ROS 2, CAD- und URDF-Pipelines, OpenUSD-Assets, HIL/SIL-Umgebungen und Controller-Entwicklungsschleifen.
• Assist GPU beschleunigte Implementierungen und skalierte aus fortschrittlichen Simulationsalgorithmen heraus.
• Mentor Ingenieure und tragen technische Führung in der gesamten Organisation! Was wir sehen müssen:
• Eine Erfolgsbilanz von Bau- oder führender Simulationssoftware, die in den Bereichen Produktionstechnik, Robotik, Industriemaschinen, Automobil, Luft- und Raumfahrt, Fertigung oder angrenzenden Bereichen verwendet wird.
• 15+ Jahre einschlägige Branchenerfahrung, die nachhaltige Auswirkungen in der Simulationsentwicklung, dem Systemdesign oder der Engineering-Software in großem Maßstab zeigt.
• Master- oder PhD-Abschluss in einer relevanten Disziplin (z. B. Maschinenbau, Robotik, Informatik, angewandte Mathematik oder Physik) oder gleichwertige Expertise durch Berufserfahrung
• Tiefe Kenntnisse in mehreren der folgenden Bereiche: Mehrkörperdynamik, eingeschränkte Systeme, Kontakt und Reibung, Artikulationen, flexible Körper, Kabel- oder Drahtsimulation, Deformables, FEM, Solver-Design, numerische Integration, Steifigkeitshandhabung oder Modellreduktion.
• Erfahrung in der Validierung von Simulatoren gegen physikalische Systeme, einschließlich einer Kombination aus Testkorrelation, Kalibrierung, HIL/SIL-Workflows oder Controller-Co-Simulation.
• Arbeitsfluss in Robotik-System-Integration und mechanischen Engineering-Toolchains, einschließlich ROS 2, Simulink, Simscape und Modell-Pipelines basierend auf CAD, URDF, MJCF oder OpenU
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez NVIDIA, nous construisons les technologies de simulation qui alimentent l'avenir de la robotique, de l'IA industrielle, des systèmes autonomes et des jumeaux numériques. NVIDIA Les technologies de simulation Omniverse sont utilisées pour alimenter les systèmes d'apprentissage du renforcement, former des robots, simuler des usines et des entrepôts, et permettre des jumeaux numériques physiquement précis. À mesure que la simulation devient fondamentale pour la robotique et l'automatisation industrielle, les exigences en matière de fidélité physique augmentent rapidement. L'automobile, l'aérospatiale, la fabrication et la robotique nécessitent des simulations qui vont au-delà de la plausibilité visuelle et atteignent la précision prédictive de qualité technique. Nous sommes à la recherche d'un leader technique senior qui peut augmenter la fidélité, la robustesse et la valeur pratique de notre pile de simulation d'ingénierie pour la robotique, l'automatisation et les jumelles numériques industrielles. Plutôt que de se concentrer sur la plausibilité visuelle, c'est un rôle pour quelqu'un qui a déjà construit la technologie de simulation utilisée pour prendre des décisions sur les machines réelles : robots, équipements industriels, véhicules, assemblages flexibles, ou d'autres systèmes électromécaniques complexes. Vous devriez être à l'aise de transformer un comportement ambigu dans le monde réel en modèles traçables, en choisissant le bon niveau de fidélité pour le problème, en validant ces modèles contre les données, et en conduisant l'implémentation de qualité de production dans un environnement moderne de calcul accéléré basé sur l'IA. Dans ce rôle, vous aiderez à définir et à mettre en œuvre la prochaine génération de capacités de simulation haute fidélité à travers la robotique NVIDIA et la pile de simulation industrielle. Vous travaillerez sur des problèmes de mécanique difficiles qui comptent dans le monde réel, y compris des machines articulées, des interactions riches en contacts, des systèmes de friction, des composants déformables ou conformes, et des éléments flexibles tels que des câbles, des fils, des dresspacks ou des assemblages de type harnais. Vous collaborerez étroitement avec les équipes de la physique, de la robotique, des jumeaux numériques, des commandes et des logiciels GPU pour transformer les méthodes de simulation avancées en capacités de développement et de produit évolutives. Ce que vous allez faire:
• Concevoir et développer des systèmes avancés de simulation physique pour la robotique et les jumelles numériques industrielles.
• Collaborer avec des équipes de PhysX, Newton, Omniverse et Isaac robotique.
• Apportez des méthodologies modernes de simulation industrielle et d'ingénierie dans la pile de simulation évolutive NVIDIA.
• Concevoir, évaluer et améliorer les méthodes pour la dynamique multicorps, le contact et la friction, le comportement du corps flexible, les déformables et les résolveurs numériques connexes.
• Intégrer la simulation avec des flux de travail robotiques impliquant des pipelines ROS 2, CAO et URDF, des actifs OpenUSD, des environnements HIL/SIL et des boucles de développement de contrôleurs.
• Aider GPU à accélérer les implémentations et à sortir des algorithmes de simulation avancés.
• Mentor ingénieurs et de contribuer au leadership technique dans toute l'organisation! Ce que nous devons voir :
• Une expérience de construction ou de premier logiciel de simulation utilisé dans les domaines de l'ingénierie de production, de la robotique, des machines industrielles, de l'automobile, de l'aérospatiale, de la fabrication ou des domaines adjacents.
• 15 ans et plus d'expérience pertinente de l'industrie, démontrant un impact soutenu sur le développement de simulations, la conception de systèmes ou les logiciels d'ingénierie à l'échelle.
• Maîtrise ou doctorat dans une discipline pertinente (p. ex. génie mécanique, robotique, informatique, mathématiques appliquées ou physique), ou une expertise équivalente grâce à l'expérience professionnelle
• Connaissance approfondie dans plusieurs des domaines suivants : dynamique multicorps, systèmes limités, contact et frottement, articulations, corps flexibles, simulation de câbles ou de fils, déformables, FEM, conception de solveur, intégration numérique, manutention de la rigidité ou réduction du modèle.

jobs.description:
For two decades, NVIDIA has pioneered visual computing, the art and science of computer graphics. With our invention of the GPU - the engine of modern visual computing - the field has expanded to encompass PC games, movie production, product design, medical diagnosis, scientific research and all things AI. Today, AI and visual computing are becoming increasingly central to how people interact with technology, and there has never been a more exciting time to join our team.

We are now looking for a Principal Developer Technology Engineer to focus on advanced rendering, including path tracing and neural graphics, and the broader adoption of AI technology in games.

What you’ll be doing:

• Collaborate with some of the most innovative, leading AAA developers throughout the world to optimize GPU and system performance, to ensure the fastest and most fluid gameplay with beautiful path traced neural rendering and complex AI behaviors.

• Develop, profile, optimize, and tune neural rendering algorithms and AI models to make the most of available computing resources.

• Collaborate with the architecture and driver teams at NVIDIA in ensuring the best possible experience on current generation hardware, and on determining trends and features for next generation architectures.

• Play with the latest GPU technology to develop new techniques using GPUs, build technical demos, write whitepapers and present your work at conferences.

What we need to see:

• Masters degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related computationally focused science degree (or equivalent experience).

• You have 15+ years of relevant work experience or research.

• Proficiency in C++ with strong software development, optimization, debugging skills, and a strong software engineering background.

• Very strong math skills, including linear algebra and calculus for problem-solving and performance modeling.

• Excellent knowledge of real-time graphics and GPU technologies (real-time rendering algorithms including ray/path tracing, shaders, shading languages, and APIs such as DirectX or Vulkan).

• Hands-on experience with low-level performance optimizations.

• In-depth expertise with CPU and GPU architecture fundamentals.

• A solid understanding of AI fundamentals with the ability to not only use AI tools for programming productivity but also to design new solutions.

• Good communication, organization and prioritization skills.

• Open to travel for on-site visits with developers and for conferences.

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

• Professional experience in machine learning algorithms and applications.

• Experience optimizing inference and training workloads.

• Solid understanding of Neural Graphics techniques.

• Experience with Windows or Linux driver development.

#LI-Hybrid

Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. For Poland: The base salary range is 483,750 PLN - 838,500 PLN.

jobs.description:
Reinforcement learning post-training is driving some of the most significant capability gains in AI today. It is the process that teaches a model to reason through hard problems, follow complex instructions, and act as an autonomous agent. It is also one of the hardest infrastructure challenges in the field. RL requires inference, rollout generation, and training running in a continuous loop. The rollout step is what makes it hard: the model must interact with environments, tools, and other models to produce the signal that drives learning. Coordinating actor, critic, and reward models across heterogeneous hardware at scale pushes the limits of what distributed systems can do.

NVIDIA is building an RL Frameworks engineering team to develop the open-source tools and infrastructure that AI researchers and post-training teams depend on. The team spans the full software stack, from collaborating closely with the researchers and labs pushing the frontier, to contributing to RL frameworks like VeRL , Miles , and TorchTitan , to improving the distributed runtimes they depend on, including Ray and Monarch . Whether your strength is working with researchers to understand and address their need optimizing deep learning frameworks, or building distributed infrastructure, we want to hear from you. Come join us to build the systems that enable the next generation of AI.

What you will be doing:
You will architect and build RL post-training infrastructure that scales efficiently from experimentation on a single GPU to production across thousands of nodes. This means tuning RL training-inference-rollout loops on GPUs, CPUs, and LPUs for performance where it matters, contributing to and improving the performance and usability of open-source RL frameworks, and partnering with the teams who own them. The role also spans fault tolerance, elastic scaling, and fast restarts so long-running distributed training jobs survive failures, stragglers, and resource contention.

Beyond GPU-accelerated training, this work includes partnering with teams building CPU-driven rollout workloads, including tool-use, code execution, and agentic environments, supplying the systems and framework engineering needed to run them efficiently alongside GPU- or LPU-accelerated generation and GPU-accelerated training. It also means advocating for researcher and partner needs with NVIDIA's networking, math library, and compiler teams so the capabilities RL workloads require get prioritized and delivered, and working with hardware teams to take advantage of next-generation hardware capabilities in post-training workloads.

What we need to see:

• MS or PhD in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience)

• 5+ years of professional experience in distributed systems, high-performance computing, deep learning infrastructure, or ML systems engineering

• Strong proficiency in Python and C/C++

• Demonstrated experience building or contributing to large-scale distributed systems or runtime frameworks in production at a frontier AI lab, hyperscaler, or major technology company

• Strong verbal and written communication skills and the ability to collaborate across organizational and geographic boundaries

Depth in one or more of the following technical areas:

• Reinforcement learning for LLM post-training (RLHF, PPO, GRPO, DPO, reward modeling), including how algorithms map to distributed execution and the systems challenges they create (heterogeneous placement, rollouts, environment execution, resharding between training and generation)

• PyTorch internals, including distributed training primitives (FSDP, tensor parallelism, pipeline parallelism) and their composition

• Kubernetes runtime internals (container lifecycle, pod scheduling, resource quotas, GPU allocation)

• End-to-end distributed systems design (service boundaries, data flows, consistency models, failure modes, recovery approaches)

Rinforzare l'apprendimento post-training sta guidando alcuni dei più significativi guadagni di capacità in AI oggi. È il processo che insegna un modello a ragionare attraverso problemi duri, seguire istruzioni complesse e agire come agente autonomo. È anche una delle sfide infrastrutturali più difficili del settore. RL richiede inferenza, generazione di rollout e formazione in esecuzione in un ciclo continuo. La fase di rollout è ciò che lo rende difficile: il modello deve interagire con ambienti, strumenti e altri modelli per produrre il segnale che spinge l'apprendimento. Coordinare attore, critico e premiare i modelli in hardware eterogeneo a scala spinge i limiti di ciò che i sistemi distribuiti possono fare. NVIDIA sta costruendo un team di ingegneri RL Frameworks per sviluppare gli strumenti open source e le infrastrutture a cui i ricercatori dell'IA e i team post-formazione dipendono. Il team abbraccia lo stack completo del software, collaborando a stretto contatto con i ricercatori e i laboratori che spingono la frontiera, per contribuire a framework RL come VeRL , Miles e TorchTitan , per migliorare i runtime distribuiti su cui dipendono, tra cui Ray e Monarch . Se la vostra forza sta lavorando con i ricercatori per capire e affrontare il loro bisogno di ottimizzare i quadri di apprendimento profondo, o costruire infrastrutture distribuite, vogliamo sentire da voi. Unisciti a noi per costruire i sistemi che permettono la prossima generazione di AI. Cosa farai: Architeggerai e costruirai infrastrutture di post-formazione RL che scalano in modo efficiente dalla sperimentazione su un singolo GPU alla produzione su migliaia di nodi. Ciò significa sintonizzare i loop RL di formazione-inferenza-rollout su GPU, CPU e LPU per le prestazioni in cui conta, contribuire a e migliorare le prestazioni e l'usabilità dei framework RL open-source e collaborare con i team che li possiedono. Il ruolo riguarda anche la tolleranza dei guasti, la scalatura elastica, e riavvia così i lavori di formazione distribuiti a lungo termine sopravvivono a guasti, stragglers, e la contention delle risorse. Oltre alla formazione accelerata dalla GPU, questo lavoro include la collaborazione con i team che costruiscono carichi di lavoro basati sulla CPU, tra cui l'uso degli strumenti, l'esecuzione del codice e gli ambienti agentici, fornendo i sistemi e l'ingegneria framework necessari per eseguirli in modo efficiente insieme alla generazione accelerata dalla GPU o dalla LPU e alla formazione accelerata dalla GPU. Significa anche sostenere le esigenze del ricercatore e del partner con i team di networking, libreria di matematica e compilatore di NVIDIA, in modo che i carichi di lavoro RL di capacità richiedono ottenere priorità e consegnati, e lavorare con i team hardware per sfruttare le capacità hardware di prossima generazione nei carichi di lavoro post-formazione. Cosa dobbiamo vedere:
• MS o PhD in Informatica, Ingegneria Informatica, o un campo relativo (o esperienza equivalente)
• 5+ anni di esperienza professionale nei sistemi distribuiti, calcolo ad alte prestazioni, infrastruttura di apprendimento profondo, o ingegneria dei sistemi ML
• Forte competenza in Python e C/C++
• Costruzione di esperienze dimostrate o contribuire a sistemi distribuiti su larga scala o quadri di runtime in produzione presso un laboratorio AI di frontiera, iperscaler, o società di tecnologia
• Forte capacità di comunicazione verbale e scritta e la capacità di collaborare attraverso confini organizzativi e geografici Profondità in una o più delle seguenti aree tecniche:
• Reinforcement learning for LLM post-training (RLHF, PPO, GRPO, DPO, premiazione), incluso il modo in cui gli algoritmi mappano l'esecuzione distribuita e le sfide dei sistemi che creano (posizione eterogenea, rollout, esecuzione dell'ambiente, resharding tra formazione e generazione)
• Gli interni di PyTorch, compresi i primitivi di formazione distribuiti (FSDP, parallelismo tensore, parallelismo pipeline) e la loro composizione
• Interni a tempo di esecuzione Kubernetes (ciclo di vita del contenitore, programmazione del pod, quote delle risorse, allocazione della GPU)
• Progettazione di sistemi distribuiti end-to-end (finiture di servizio, flussi di dati, modelli di consistenza, modalità di guasto, approcci di recupero) Esperienza in una delle folli
descriptionByLocale.en:
Reinforcement learning post-training is driving some of the most significant capability gains in AI today. It is the process that teaches a model to reason through hard problems, follow complex instructions, and act as an autonomous agent. It is also one of the hardest infrastructure challenges in the field. RL requires inference, rollout generation, and training running in a continuous loop. The rollout step is what makes it hard: the model must interact with environments, tools, and other models to produce the signal that drives learning. Coordinating actor, critic, and reward models across heterogeneous hardware at scale pushes the limits of what distributed systems can do.

NVIDIA is building an RL Frameworks engineering team to develop the open-source tools and infrastructure that AI researchers and post-training teams depend on. The team spans the full software stack, from collaborating closely with the researchers and labs pushing the frontier, to contributing to RL frameworks like VeRL , Miles , and TorchTitan , to improving the distributed runtimes they depend on, including Ray and Monarch . Whether your strength is working with researchers to understand and address their need optimizing deep learning frameworks, or building distributed infrastructure, we want to hear from you. Come join us to build the systems that enable the next generation of AI.

What you will be doing:
You will architect and build RL post-training infrastructure that scales efficiently from experimentation on a single GPU to production across thousands of nodes. This means tuning RL training-inference-rollout loops on GPUs, CPUs, and LPUs for performance where it matters, contributing to and improving the performance and usability of open-source RL frameworks, and partnering with the teams who own them. The role also spans fault tolerance, elastic scaling, and fast restarts so long-running distributed training jobs survive failures, stragglers, and resource contention.

Beyond GPU-accelerated training, this work includes partnering with teams building CPU-driven rollout workloads, including tool-use, code execution, and agentic environments, supplying the systems and framework engineering needed to run them efficiently alongside GPU- or LPU-accelerated generation and GPU-accelerated training. It also means advocating for researcher and partner needs with NVIDIA's networking, math library, and compiler teams so the capabilities RL workloads require get prioritized and delivered, and working with hardware teams to take advantage of next-generation hardware capabilities in post-training workloads.

What we need to see:

• MS or PhD in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience)

• 5+ years of professional experience in distributed systems, high-performance computing, deep learning infrastructure, or ML systems engineering

• Strong proficiency in Python and C/C++

• Demonstrated experience building or contributing to large-scale distributed systems or runtime frameworks in production at a frontier AI lab, hyperscaler, or major technology company

• Strong verbal and written communication skills and the ability to collaborate across organizational and geographic boundaries

Depth in one or more of the following technical areas:

• Reinforcement learning for LLM post-training (RLHF, PPO, GRPO, DPO, reward modeling), including how algorithms map to distributed execution and the systems challenges they create (heterogeneous placement, rollouts, environment execution, resharding between training and generation)

• PyTorch internals, including distributed training primitives (FSDP, tensor parallelism, pipeline parallelism) and their composition

• Kubernetes runtime internals (container lifecycle, pod scheduling, resource quotas, GPU allocation)

• End-to-end distributed systems design (service boundaries, data flows, consistency models, failure modes, recovery approaches)

Verstärkungslernen nach dem Training treibt heute einige der wichtigsten Fähigkeiten in der KI voran. Es ist der Prozess, der ein Modell lehrt, schwierige Probleme zu durchdenken, komplexen Anweisungen zu folgen und als autonomer Agent zu handeln. Es ist auch eine der schwierigsten Infrastrukturherausforderungen in diesem Bereich. RL erfordert Inferenz, Rollout-Generierung und Training in einer kontinuierlichen Schleife. Der Rollout-Schritt macht es schwierig: Das Modell muss mit Umgebungen, Tools und anderen Modellen interagieren, um das Signal zu erzeugen, das das Lernen antreibt. Die Koordination von Akteur-, Kritiker- und Belohnungsmodellen über heterogene Hardware in großem Maßstab erweitert die Grenzen dessen, was verteilte Systeme leisten können. NVIDIA baut ein RL Frameworks Engineering-Team auf, um die Open-Source-Tools und Infrastruktur zu entwickeln, auf die KI-Forscher und Post-Training-Teams angewiesen sind. Das Team umfasst den gesamten Software-Stack, von der engen Zusammenarbeit mit den Forschern und Labors, die die Grenze überschreiten, über den Beitrag zu RL-Frameworks wie VeRL, Miles und TorchTitan bis hin zur Verbesserung der verteilten Laufzeiten, von denen sie abhängen, einschließlich Ray und Monarch. Ob Ihre Stärke darin besteht, mit Forschern zusammenzuarbeiten, um ihre Bedürfnisse zu verstehen und zu erfüllen, um Deep Learning-Frameworks zu optimieren oder eine verteilte Infrastruktur aufzubauen, möchten wir von Ihnen hören. Kommen Sie zu uns, um die Systeme zu bauen, die die nächste Generation von KI ermöglichen. Was Sie tun werden: Sie erstellen und bauen eine RL-Post-Training-Infrastruktur, die effizient vom Experimentieren mit einer einzigen GPU bis zur Produktion über Tausende von Knoten skaliert. Dies bedeutet, RL-Trainings-Inference-Rollout-Schleifen auf GPUs, CPUs und LPUs auf die Leistung abzustimmen, wo es darauf ankommt, zur Leistung und Benutzerfreundlichkeit von Open-Source-RL-Frameworks beizutragen und diese zu verbessern und mit den Teams zusammenzuarbeiten, die sie besitzen. Die Rolle umfasst auch Fehlertoleranz, elastische Skalierung und schnelle Neustarts, so dass lang laufende verteilte Trainingsaufträge Ausfälle, Nachzügler und Ressourcenkonflikte überleben. Neben dem GPU-beschleunigten Training umfasst diese Arbeit die Zusammenarbeit mit Teams, die CPU-gesteuerte Rollout-Workloads erstellen, einschließlich Tool-Use, Codeausführung und Agentic-Umgebungen, die Bereitstellung der Systeme und des Framework-Engineerings, die erforderlich sind, um sie effizient neben GPU- oder LPU-beschleunigter Generation und GPU-beschleunigtem Training auszuführen. Es bedeutet auch, sich für die Bedürfnisse von Forschern und Partnern mit NVIDIAs Netzwerk-, Mathematikbibliotheks- und Compilerteams einzusetzen, damit die Funktionen, die RL-Workloads erfordern, priorisiert und bereitgestellt werden, und mit Hardwareteams zusammenzuarbeiten, um die Vorteile der Hardwarefunktionen der nächsten Generation in Post-Training-Workloads zu nutzen. Was wir sehen müssen:
• MS oder PhD in Informatik, Computer Engineering oder einem verwandten Bereich (oder gleichwertige Erfahrung)
• 5+ Jahre Berufserfahrung in verteilten Systemen, High-Performance-Computing, Deep-Learning-Infrastruktur oder ML-Systemtechnik
• Starke Kenntnisse in Python und C/C++
• Demonstrierte Erfahrung beim Aufbau oder Beitrag zu großen verteilten Systemen oder Laufzeit-Frameworks in der Produktion in einem grenzüberschreitenden KI-Labor, Hyperscaler oder großen Technologieunternehmen
• Starke verbale und schriftliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und die Fähigkeit, über organisatorische und geografische Grenzen hinweg zusammenzuarbeiten Tiefe in einem oder mehreren der folgenden technischen Bereiche:
• Verstärkungslernen für das LLM-Post-Training (RLHF, PPO, GRPO, DPO, Belohnungsmodellierung), einschließlich der Art und Weise, wie Algorithmen der verteilten Ausführung und den von ihnen verursachten Systemherausforderungen zugeordnet werden (heterogene Platzierung, Rollouts, Umgebungsausführung, Resharding zwischen Training und Generation)
• PyTorch-Interna, einschließlich verteilter Trainingsprimitive (FSDP, Tensorparallelismus, Pipelineparallelismus) und ihre Zusammensetzung
• Kubernetes Runtime Interna (Container Lifecycle, Pod Scheduling, Ressourcenquoten, GPU-Allokation)
